independent_computation.method: The scenario input tuple (level, ability-rank order, items -> AP, splinters, r_spheres, target MR) is defined in scripts/golden_snapshot.py, which runbook R-18 forbids reading and which is absent from data/. I therefore inverted the problem: enumerate every damage value Syndra's wiki rows can produce, for every ability, every rank, every sphere count 1..7, over integer AP 0..1600, and ask which of {650.0, 840.0} is wiki-conforming and under which configurations.
closed_forms_used: R = n_spheres * (base_R[r] + 0.20*AP), n in 1..7  (audit: 'per Sphere x user-set sphere count')

exact_hits_for_840.AP=0: R rank 2 x 7 spheres = 7*(120 + 0) = 840  -- identically the wiki's 'Maximum Magic Damage' rank-2 row
exact_hits_for_840.AP=1000: W rank 5 magic = 190 + 0.65*1000 = 840 ; also R rank 1 x 3

discriminating_observations: 840 is a verbatim wiki quantity: Unleashed Power rank 2 'Maximum Magic Damage' = 840 = 7 spheres x 120 per sphere, and it is the only Syndra value equal to 840 in a no-item (AP=0) configuration -- the configuration golden/champion-mechanic probes in this repo customarily use ('level 18, no items', data/worklists/e9-audit-task-1.md step 6).
650 is reachable by NO Syndra row at AP=0; it requires AP to land on one of exactly seven values in 0..1600.

840 - 650 = 190, which is exactly Force of Will's rank-5 base damage, and 650 = 0.65*1000 is exactly Force of Will's AP term at AP=1000. So the second self-consistent reconstruction is: the leaf is the W rank-5 magic hit at AP=1000, correct value 190 + 650 = 840, with the old 650 having dropped the flat base term. That reconstruction is thematically consistent with the scenario name's '60' (60 Splinters of Wrath is precisely the Force-of-Will threshold, per the P/W wiki text).

A pure rank change at fixed AP cannot explain the delta for any single ability (Q/E steps are 35, W steps 30, R steps 40 per rank; 190 is a multiple of none), and a pure sphere-count change cannot either (650/840 = 65/84 is not a ratio of two integers <= 7). So the two values are not the same event under one flipped parameter: either the event identity at index 6 shifted (both values on-formula, AP in {250,600,650,800}), or one value is off-formula.

Enumerating the union of admissible APs: 8 APs make only 840 wiki-conforming, 3 make only 650 conforming, 4 make both conforming (in which case the index-6 identity shifted and the post-fix value is the engine's answer). Every self-consistent reconstruction I could build leaves 840 on-formula.
independent_computation.conclusion: 840.0 is a wiki-conforming Syndra damage value in the plausible configurations (most cleanly: Unleashed Power rank 2 with 7 spheres at 0 AP = the wiki's 'Maximum Magic Damage' row, or Force of Will rank 5 magic at 1000 AP = 190 + 65%*1000). 650.0 is conforming only for a narrow set of AP values and is unreachable in the no-item configuration; nothing in the cached wiki text supports 650 as the correct value for this leaf.

limitations: The scenario input tuple for 'syndra_custom_order_60' is not present anywhere under data/ (grep for 'custom_order' and 'manual_target' across the whole export returns nothing) and is not derivable from docs/math-foundations.md. The computation above is therefore a configuration-inverted argument, not a point evaluation of the scenario.

If the scenario's true AP is 700 or 750 (both plausible full-build AP totals) and the leaf is a Dark Sphere / Scatter the Weak hit, then 650 would be the conforming value and 840 would not be reachable from any Syndra row; that is the single world in which this verdict is wrong. A follow-up with access to the scenario tuple (AP, ability ranks, r_spheres, target MR) settles it in one evaluation.
